shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files -g '"'!*node_modules*'"' -g '"'!*.lock'"' -g '"'!package-lock.json'"' -g '"'!pnpm-lock.yaml'"' -g '"'!yarn.lock'"' | sort | head -200 && find node_modules/next/dist/docs -maxdepth 3 -type f | head -80"

/bin/bash -lc 'cat AGENTS.md && cat package.json && cat next.config.ts && cat tsconfig.json && for f in pages/_app.tsx pages/_document.tsx pages/index.tsx pages/about.tsx; do echo "--- $f"; sed -n '"'1,240p' \""'$f"; done && for f in node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/02-project-structure.md node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/03-layouts-and-pages.md node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/04-linking-and-navigating.md node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/14-metadata-and-og-images.md; do echo "--- $f"; sed -n '"'1,240p' \""'$f"; done'

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/03-layouts-and-pages.md && rg -n \"export const metadata|<html lang|Root Layout\" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/03-layouts-and-pages.md node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/14-metadata-and-og-images.md && rg --files -g 'favicon*' -g 'public/**' -g 'pages/**' -g 'app/**' -g '"'!node_modules'"' && git status --short"
/bin/bash -lc 'git status --short && git diff -- tsconfig.json package.json && find pages app -maxdepth 3 -type f -print 2>/dev/null | sort && git diff --stat'

/bin/bash -lc 'rmdir pages 2>/dev/null || true
git status --short
git diff -- tsconfig.json pages
rg --files app'
